description: Pack items into the smallest fitting carton (bounded heuristic) — Checks whether up to 50 box-shaped items (axis-aligned, 90-degree rotations, optional this-side-up lock, optional weights) fit into any of up to 20 candidate cartons, and recommends the smallest-volume carton for which a packing was found, with coordinates for every item. For shipping and fulfilment agents sizing a parcel. The packing is a greedy extreme-point HEURISTIC with a fixed step cap, not

maxWeight.description: Maximum content weight; requires every item to carry a weight.

items.description: At most 50 item lines and 50 units in total (sum of qty).

thisSideUp.description: Keep h vertical (only rotation about the vertical axis allowed).

weight.description: Weight in one unit shared with maxWeight.

name: carton-fit
